# Layer of each workspace crate, for dist/scripts/test-affected.py and the layered test gate (dist/scripts/testlayers.py). First matching glob wins; a crate with no match is an ERROR.
# base: libraries below the core. core: the core and what only the core side uses. agent: the agent program (chat, tools, services). ui: the shell and the drawing/tile interface.
# apps: the tile crates. tools: host-side tools that are not part of the running system (release checker, store server, SDK emulator, lint).
# First draft: while the shell program holds the core, a ui change still rebuilds the one `iyakki` program (see dist/buildroot/layers.txt).
iyakki-tile-api   ui
iyakki-tile-kit   ui
iyakki-tile-*     apps
iyakki-shell      ui
iyakki-apps       apps
iyakki-uikit      ui
iyakki-ui-sdk     ui
iyakki-app-sample apps
iyakki-sdk-tile   apps
iyakki-app-markdown apps
iyakki-ui-preview ui
iyakki-ui-client  ui
iyakki-ui-rpc     ui
iyakki-ui-bin     ui
iyakki-web        ui
iyakki-core*      core
iyakki-compose    core   # the composition root: names both the agent and the UI (alpha.6 split F)
iyakki-agent      agent
iyakki-remote     core
iyakki-memx        core   # the knowledge base, embedder and history (F-SPLIT-03), below the agent
iyakki-disksx      core   # the disk engine (F-SPLIT-03), below the agent
iyakki-flowsx      core   # pure FLOWS parts (F-SPLIT-03), below the agent; same layer as the engine it builds on
iyakki-flow*      core
iyakki-usb        core
iyakki-connect    core

# host-side tools
iyakki-relcheck     tools
iyakki-store-server tools
iyakki-sdk-emulator tools
iyakki-lint         tools

# Everything below is the base layer, named one by one on purpose: there is NO catch-all. A workspace crate with no line here fails
# `python3 dist/scripts/testlayers.py check` (and the test layer_split), so a new crate must be given a layer when it is added.
iyakki-accounts           base

iyakki-diskcrypt          base
